slides.headline: SET UP CLAUDE *the right way*
slides.body: Five things to turn on before you ask it a single question. Takes *five minutes*.
slides.close: Most people skip every one of these and then say AI is *overrated*.

slides.headline: THE *profile* BOX
slides.body: Settings, then Profile. The box asking what Claude should know about you.
slides.close: It reads that before *every single chat* you ever have.

slides.headline: TURN ON *memory*
slides.body: One switch on the same settings page.
slides.close: What you told it Tuesday is *still there Friday*.

slides.headline: ONE PROJECT PER *ongoing thing*
slides.body: Job hunt, side business, one class. Your files go in one time.
slides.close: Every chat inside it already knows *your whole situation*.

slides.headline: CHECK *which model* YOU ARE ON
slides.body: Tap the model name at the top of your chat. There is a list in there, and a setting for how hard it thinks.
slides.close: The quick one is for quick questions. *Everything else deserves better.*

slides.headline: LET CLAUDE *interview you*
slides.body: You do not have to write that profile yourself. Tell it to interview you and write it for you.
slides.close: It asks better questions than *I would have*.

slides.headline: COMMENT *SETUP*
slides.body: I will send you the free guide with my exact profile text and all five steps written out.
slides.close: Free, no email needed. Save this and send it to whoever *just downloaded Claude*.
